component.name: Immich Mount
component.summary: Your Immich photos and videos as a drive in your file manager

description.p: Browse a self-hosted Immich library as an ordinary folder in Files or Dolphin and in every file dialog: the timeline, albums, people and places. Thumbnails come from the server, originals download only when something opens them, and photos copied into its Upload folder are uploaded. The app opens in the interface native to the desktop: GTK and libadwaita on GNOME, Kirigami on KDE Plasma.

Immich Mount is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Immich project or FUTO. "Immich" is used only to describe the server this software works with, and remains the mark of its owner.
